inherits: Lab2 research-telemetry-v1 ten-column release; adds event_date only

columns.name: site
columns.meaning: Site supplied by the unchanged Lab 2 registry

columns.name: ingest_time_utc
columns.meaning: Source arrival timestamp used to order revisions

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: Source object identifier; resolve through trusted manifests

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: One-based physical record ordinal, excluding CSV header

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of original source object bytes, not a row hash

columns.name: event_date
columns.meaning: UTC calendar date derived from event_time_utc
